entries.summary: CLI changes across 1 file(s) (+132/−52).

testNames: custom agents do not make bundled fast-mode workers fail validation

ai.title: Base agent spawn gating skips non-spawning workers
ai.summary: The `loadAgentDefinitions` function in `cli/src/utils/local-agent-registry.ts` now gates auto-added user agents to base agents that actually support spawning, checking for `spawn_agents`, `spawn_agent_inline` tool names, or a `handleSteps` definition. Previously, any agent with an ID starting with 'base' and a `spawnableAgents` field received user agents appended, which could incorrectly add children to non-spawning worker agents that share the 'base' id prefix. The new test 'custom agents do not make bundled fast-mode workers fail validation' asserts that `base3-fast-worker-deepseek-flash` and its evals variant keep an empty `spawnableAgents` list and lack `spawn_agents` in `toolNames`.
ai.evidence: In `cli/src/utils/local-agent-registry.ts`, the `loadAgentDefinitions` function's loop that auto-adds user agent IDs to `spawnableAgents` now checks `def.toolNames?.includes('spawn_agents') || def.toolNames?.includes('spawn_agent_inline') || def.handleSteps` before adding, with the comment 'Non-spawning workers also start with base; keep their child list empty.'
ai.unknowns: The rollout status and whether this affects agent spawning behavior for users is not visible in the diff.

eli5.text: The CLI now only lets your custom helper agents attach themselves to the main orchestrator agent, not to the lightweight worker processes that share a similar name but never spawn helpers. Developers who install custom agents into their projects will see the agent list behave the same as before, but the worker processes run faster because they no longer try to track helper agents they will never use. No action is required from you.

testNames: keeps the COD-760 stage verdicts on fetch completion

ai.title: Rename COD-760 first party and house verdict fields in ads fetch
ai.summary: The `ADS_FETCH_COMPLETED_FIELDS` allowlist in `common/src/util/axiom-only-log.ts` renames `first_party_outcome` to `direct_result` and `house_outcome` to `house_result`, aligning the field names with the existing `direct_` prefix convention on `no_fill_reason` codes. The accompanying `no_fill_reason` doc comment replaces the previous `first_party_`/`house_`-prefixed verdict codes with a fresh enumerated set (`direct_` + `direct_result`, `house_campaign_empty`, `timed_out`, `no_paid_source_asked`, etc.). The decision-contract test keeps the COD-760 stage verdicts on fetch completion verifies the renamed fields are emitted and the old names are no longer allowlisted.
ai.evidence: In `common/src/util/axiom-only-log.ts`, the `ADS_FETCH_COMPLETED_FIELDS` allowlist renames `first_party_outcome` to `direct_result` and `house_outcome` to `house_result`, and the `no_fill_reason` doc comment replaces the old `first_party_`/`house_`-prefixed verdict codes with a new enumerated code set (`direct_`, `house_campaign_empty`, `timed_out`, `no_paid_source_asked`, etc.). The test keeps the COD-760 stage verdicts on fetch completion in `common/src/util/__tests__/axiom-only-log.test.ts` asserts the renamed fields are present and the old names are gone.
ai.unknowns: Which producers or dashboards still reference the old field names is not shown in the diff.

eli5.text: The internal system that logs what happens when an ad request comes back empty has been renamed: the fields that recorded the result of the first-party paid ads and the house ads are now called `direct_result` and `house_result`, matching the naming used elsewhere, and the list of plain-English reason codes in the same spot was refreshed. This affects only the Freebuff engineering team, since these are server-side telemetry fields that feed internal dashboards and the durable decision record, not something end users or advertisers configure. You will not notice any change in your coding sessions, ad experience, or account because this is bookkeeping on the server that runs the ads plumbing; the visible behavior of Freebuff is unchanged.
